description: Start with a song idea and the bands you like; Mureka 9.5 sings the result (about $0.23 a song). Three text calls write lyrics, arrange them, and identify what would clash with that arrangement. Th… text:Song idea -> text:Preferred bands -> join:Idea + musical references -> llm:Write lyrics -> join:Brief + finished lyrics -> llm:Arrange the song -> llm:What would clash? -> join:Arrangement + avoid-list -> music:Sing; returns audio (mureka-v9.5/generate-song) saved to disk (file path in result). Runs on NanoGPT — $0.55 deposit per call, paid in Nano (XNO) — settles at actual model cost + 20%, change returned; no account needed. Example: Audio sample (https://nanoodle.com/examples/gallery/#sing). A 170-second generated closing-credits song. Gemini 3.8 Flash reported clear gentle acoustic vocals and a chorus matching the supplied lyrics. This sample was recorded with MiniMax Music 3, before the tool moved to Mureka 9.5. This is model-assisted audio review, not human listening sign-off. It can also be paid in NEAR: add "_pay_with": "near" for a NEAR quote, send the exact amount in one transfer, then call again with the same arguments plus _payment_id, _payment_tx and _payment_sender.

Arrange_the_song.description: System prompt; default: "Write one compact music-generator prompt: a single paragraph, at most 60 words and 450 characters. Use the supplied i..."; optional

Preferred_bands.description: Text; default: "Portishead, Massive Attack, Tricky"; optional

Song_idea.description: Text; default: "Write a wistful 90s trip-hop track about the singularity."; optional

What_would_clash.description: System prompt; default: "Read the actual arrangement. Name exactly three specific musical choices that would undermine its groove, instruments..."; optional

Write_lyrics.description: System prompt; default: "Write original, singable lyrics from the song idea and musical references. Maximum 200 words. Use concrete images, an..."; optional

_pay_with.description: Payment rail for the quote: "nano" (default, XNO over x402), "near" (native NEAR) or "usdc" (Circle-issued USDC on NEAR).

_payment_id.description: Payment id from this tool's previous payment-required response. Phase 3 only: after /x402/watch closes with status paid, call again with the same arguments plus this id to open the RESULTS stream. Do not pass it while payment is still pending — monitor the watch SSE first.

_payment_sender.description: The NEAR account you paid from. It locates the transaction; the refund goes to the transaction's signer.

_payment_tx.description: Hash (base58) of the exact quoted payment: one native Transfer for NEAR, or one ft_transfer on the quoted token contract for USDC.
